goal: 重构真实运行的手机横屏 UI，让3D游戏世界成为主体，并以情境面板和单一主行动承载工厂、战区与战斗操作。

player_outcome.target_player: 首次接触本作的手机轻量SLG玩家
player_outcome.control: 点击世界对象、城镇节点或角色技能
player_outcome.threat: 当前战区压力与战斗预警
player_outcome.choice: 执行当前唯一主行动，或进入一个相邻准备动作
player_outcome.feedback: 世界、上下文卡与状态边缘信息同步响应
player_outcome.outcome: 能指出当前目标、主要风险和下一步行动，同时持续看见游戏世界

constraints.asset_policy: only repository-owned or licensed assets; online references are structural comparison only
accessibility: critical state not encoded by colour alone

quality_bar.comparison: At 844x390 the world-driven screens keep roughly 65% of the viewport visually open and expose one dominant action; the battle HUD no longer cuts the world with full-width opaque bands.
limits: Screenshots cannot prove fun, target-player understanding, iOS Safari behavior, or target-device performance.

scenarios.purpose: Expose the factory, selected war-zone stage, legion formation, active battle HUD, gameplay field guide, and settings experience/data states at canonical mobile landscape sizes.
scenarios.player_question: Can the player see the game world, identify the current objective, find the single primary action, or locate one needed help/settings topic without searching?

ownership.public_adapter: fresh fixture state followed by normal screen methods, signals, and shipping command routes

setup.entry: launch the authored UI review capture against the real main scene
setup.state: fresh state for factory and stage 1-1; deterministic active battle fixture; authored default legion, help, settings experience and local-data states
setup.camera_or_view: shipping factory camera, war-zone screen, legion formation, battle camera, help field guide, and settings section navigation

stimulus.action: open factory through shipping screen method
open war zone and selected stage through shipping screen method
open legion formation, gameplay help, and both settings sections through shipping screen methods
start deterministic battle fixture and let HUD receive real snapshots

observations.source: runtime captures, node geometry, and UI smoke assertions
observations.window: stable frame after 4-6 process frames per screen

determinism.clock: fixed fixture state; battle simulation uses repository deterministic tick
determinism.warmup: 20 scene frames plus 4-6 frames after each screen transition
determinism.temporal_isolation: fresh Godot process and fresh in-memory save fixture

strict_regression_route.command: godot --headless --path project-a -s tools/run_ui_smoke_tests.gd && godot --headless --path project-a -s tools/run_help_screen_tests.gd && godot --headless --path project-a -s tools/run_settings_screen_tests.gd && godot --headless --path project-a -s tools/run_legion_screen_tests.gd && godot --headless --path project-a -s tools/run_battle_hud_screen_tests.gd && godot --headless --path project-a -s tools/capture_ui_review.gd
strict_regression_route.isolation: fresh processes, fixed fixture state, viewport and output filenames

scenarios.reset: discard in-memory fixture and start a fresh Godot process
failure_conditions: primary action is clipped or unavailable
UI bypasses normal screen or command owners
limitations: Visual comparison is directional because 3D animation timing is not frame-locked.
Target-player comprehension requires an uncoached human session.

quality_gates.claim: Real screens boot and shipping actions remain wired.
The world dominates and the current objective plus one primary action are visually clear.
assertions: world-driven screens visually retain roughly 65% open world
text hierarchy is game-like rather than dashboard-like

quality_gates.claim: The redesigned UI remains usable at required landscape sizes and safe areas.
assertions: primary touch targets remain at least 48px
844x390 and 568x320 do not clip primary actions

quality_gates.claim: A fresh target player identifies goal, risk, and next action within two seconds.
assertions: uncoached target-player observation confirms two-second answer
player explains failure and recovery route

ownership.surface: shared App Shell, world HUD, war-zone, legion, help and battle HUD
ownership.public_contract: UI projects state and emits existing signals/commands without direct domain mutation
